notes.title: Game Survey
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone!

We’re shaping the future of [b]Rolling Thunder: Vietnam[/b], and we want [b]YOUR[/b] opinion to help us decide what matters most in the game.  We would like to ask you to get a few minutes of your valuable time to fill out the Survey:  [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeNhIuLLAiFk7DRdbcXPJW3uf3vaPyZbKlgZBH22yT8Ur6YXg/viewform?usp=header"]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeNhIuLLAiFk7DRdbcXPJW3uf3vaPyZbKlgZBH22yT8Ur6YXg/viewform?usp=header[/url]



Thank you very much![/p]

notes.title: Moped, Smoke and Leaning
notes.notes:
[h3]New Vehicle: [i]Viper Moped[/i][/h3][p]The long-awaited Viper moped is here!
You’ll find it waiting for you in the [b]PAVN Camp[/b] — perfect for rapid insertions or joyrides through the jungle. Keep in mind this is our first Land Vehicle and very much Work in Progress![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Leaning Mechanic (Q + E)[/h3][p]You can now [b]lean left and right using Q and E — but only while aiming[/b].[/p][p]This is a big step toward more tactical, immersive infantry combat.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/d128b0f7d6ae479f244b31388bc2b81f730eb3ee.gif"][/img]
[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Smoke Grenades[/h3][p]Smoke grenades have arrived![/p][list][*][p][b]Duration:[/b] 60 seconds[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loadouts:[/b] Look for Assault | Smoke and Sniper | Smoke
(Tip: Yes, the loadout list is scrollable!)[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/b18e975fe6c67687052eb7e2d7d119e5de4877e0.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Improved Helicopter Flight Physics[/h3][p]Flying choppers is now smoother and more intuitive — we’ve reduced the required angle of attack for directional movement, resulting in [b]more responsive and enjoyable controls[/b].[/p]

notes.title: Dangerous Sky
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Everyone! — we're excited to drop the latest update!  

AH-1G Cobra Attack Helicopter The feared Cobra has entered the battlefield! This multi-crew helicopter is built for destruction. Gunner operates the iconic M134 Minigun — fast, brutal, and precise. Pilot fires a salvo of 14 Hellfire-style rockets — great for soft targets and light vehicles. This is just the beginning: the AH-1G was known for its modularity.
Expect more loadout variants soon, like dual miniguns or grenade launchers!  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/99bd25ce54e7da1c3fc8aae8204239261f145f2e.png"][/img]New Countermeasure — Russian Strela-2 To keep the skies fair (and dangerous), we've added the Strela-2 MANPADS. A heat-seeking, shoulder-launched missile system. It's still work in progress, but once you get used to its quirks, it can be lethal to helicopters.  Master it, and you’ll be the bane of any Helicopter crew.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/7fc23485a8e19d2bc2dbb1b37ae70cea33bfbe89.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/0558e131d2014d40ca9e95eb589afe78b2c3f31c.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Explosive!
notes.notes:
[p][b]This week[/b] we focused on sound design and explosive gameplay improvements![/p][p]🔊 [b]Audio Improvements[/b][/p][p]Combat just got a lot more brutal. We’ve added new [b]pain and death sounds[/b] that trigger when your soldier takes a hit or goes down—making every bullet count and every casualty feel heavier. Whether you're catching a stray round or bleeding out, you'll hear the difference. We also added [b]drowning audio[/b], so slipping underwater now carries a chilling sense of urgency.
[/p][p]💥 [b]Explosive Overhaul[/b]
We’ve reworked how explosives behave. In addition to their lethal blast radius, explosives now simulate [b]shrapnel damage[/b].[/p][list][*][p]The [b]Claymore[/b] now unleashes directional shrapnel in a [b]60° arc[/b]—position it carefully.[/p][/*][*][p]The infamous [b]SMine[/b] (aka “[b]Bouncing Betty[/b]”) fires almost [b]360° of deadly fragments[/b] after launching itself out of the ground—just like its real-world counterpart.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grenades[/b] also launch Shrapnell in every direction!

[/p][/*][/list][p]Yes, you read that right: the Bouncing Betty now [b]pops up and explodes at waist height[/b], exactly where it hurts the most. Watch your step![/p][p]Stay sharp out there,
— The Rolling Thunder Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/7f6b8ab221179ee2c80105dca8c49b4a064afc28.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/3ffb77ba3a8ecf912ee8f972356081083dc52bff.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Engine Update, Optimisation and AA Gun
notes.notes:
[h2]What's new this week?,[/h2][h3][b]New Unreal Engine version,[/b][/h3][p]We have updated the demo to Unreal Engine version 5.6. This will give us better game performance and new tools to create better and more believable worlds. This update should also alleviate some of the issues we have been seeing with [b]AMD cards[/b], please let us know if you still are having issues playing with any AMD GPU.[/p][h3]Ping system,[/h3][p]You can now call out targets to your squad members by pressing middle mouse button, this places a temporary marker that only your squad members can see.[/p][h3]ZU-23 Anti-Aircraft gun,[/h3][p]A deadly tool for the PAVN forces to deal with enemy helicopters.[/p][h3]Frontlines gamemode,[/h3][p]This is a classic Attack/Defend gamemode. One team (PAVN) holds all the flags at the start of the round, while the other team (USA) have to attack and capture all flags to win. Defenders win by holding at least one flag until the round timer runs out, and the attackers win by capturing all flags. The capture order of the flags are linear, so make sure you only attack or defend the flag that is currently active (no lock icon on it)[/p][h3]Bugfixes,[/h3][p]We have worked hard to get rid of as many troublesome bugs as possible. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/0ee4feb83c80af91065b50fa47fb83c50acd9368.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Air, Land and Sea
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Everyone! We would like to announce our latest Update for the Demo:
[/p][list][*][p][b]Vehicle weapons,[/b][/p][/*][/list][p] Helicopter M60 door gunner and PBR twin 50. caliber is now working! As well as the ability to fire from vehicles as passengers (Sampan and UH-1) [/p][list][*][p][b]Boats,[/b][/p][/*][/list][p] Sampan and PBR armed patrol boats are now in the game! [/p][list][*][p][b]Assault and Secure gamemode,[/b][/p][/*][/list][p] This is based on the popular gamemode from Squad, where you have to capture flags in a pre-defined order, very much like a tug of war. Other gamemodes are currently in the work as well, and we hope to test these soon! [/p][list][*][p][b]Quality of life updates,[/b][/p][/*][/list][p] We have improved some of our audio and visual effects, as well as minor performance improvements. We also improved the placeholder M14 model.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/aef289b805e1f3b4345bcc1280b127c92851f533.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/87b85428216b064e7281903b0a0266a79f18d75d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Death from Above
notes.notes:
Today, I'm excited to introduce the Huey "Gunship", equipped with 14x Hydra 70 Rockets for close air support (CAS) missions. This powerful helicopter will provide devastating firepower from above.

In the background, you can also spot the transport variant, featuring two door-mounted, player-controlled M60 machine guns for added protection and tactical flexibility.

Get ready to dominate the skies and bring the heat to the battlefield

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260232/afb9abb92e06a5c732cd160a56bf780d71874381.jpg[/img]
